hints.title: Deduplicate and Sort
hints.text: Extract the unique elements from arr and sort them in non-decreasing order.

hints.title: Map Value to Rank
hints.text: Assign consecutive 1-indexed ranks to each sorted unique element in a lookup table.

hints.title: Transform Input Array
hints.text: Replace every element in arr with its mapped rank.

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeatedly finding minimums without sorting takes quadratic time O(N^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Deduplicating and sorting in O(N log N) allows constant time rank assignment per element.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles duplicate numbers correctly by assigning equal ranks.
